name: Stripe
summary: The payments infrastructure behind online commerce—and the next bet on stablecoins.
overview: Stripe’s advantage is the breadth of its payments infrastructure and the ease with which developers can build it into a business. The report argues that billing, tax, fraud prevention, and other services make the relationship harder to replace, while online commerce and stablecoins offer further room to grow.
